inventory_metadata.classification_source: the pinned Phase62 topology plan (a sha256-checked W63 input) plus live nvidia-a51 scheduler and fabric metadata read on the login node at 2026-08-24T10:41:17+00:00: `scontrol show topology` InfiniBand leaf/core tree and per-node Slurm feature tags. rack_id is the node's InfiniBand leaf switch, network_domain is the core switch above that leaf; both were re-derived and required to match the Phase62 record. GPU index and HCA are copied verbatim from Phase62. No measured timing, no Phase63 target and no frozen-model error was consulted.
inventory_metadata.created_by: GPU environment agent (Claude Code) on the nvidia-a51 login node, without holding any allocation
inventory_metadata.fabric_notes: nvidia-a51 B200 cluster, NDR InfiniBand three-level tree (root a51 -> ibccore* -> ibcleaf*). All six placements reuse the exact Phase62 endpoint slots, so Phase63 changes only the model KV layout. The inventory names four distinct hosts across the whole experiment, but they are never allocated together: each placement is measured in its own sequential allocation of 2 node(s) at most -- l1__r0 on prenyx0214; l1__r1 on prenyx0265; l2__r0 on prenyx0214+prenyx0215; l2__r1 on prenyx0265+prenyx0266; l3__r0 on prenyx0214+prenyx0265; l3__r1 on prenyx0215+prenyx0266. Each host exposes 8x NVIDIA B200 and NDR RDMA NICs; each endpoint uses the HCA Phase62 froze as closest in PCIe proximity to its GPU.
